title: Top K Frequent Elements
summary: Return the k values that appear most often in an array, in any order.

tests.explain: 4 appears three times and 6 twice, more often than 9 (once). Returning [6, 4] is just as good.
The only value is the most frequent one.
5 appears 4 times, 3 appears 3 times, 2 and 1 once each.

hints: First count how many times each value appears with a Map. Now the problem is: which k keys have the largest counts?
That is a top-k question on the (value, count) pairs. Keep a min-heap of size k ordered by count, and pop the least frequent pair whenever it grows past k.
Counts are at most n, so a bucket array indexed by count (bucket[c] = values seen c times) also works in O(n): read buckets from the highest count down.

complexity.time: O(n log k): counting is O(n), then each of the m distinct values costs O(log k) on a heap of size k
complexity.space: O(n) for the count map (the heap adds O(k))
